result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well structured, but several elements are clipped or inconsistent. The horizontal 'Fastest near you' carousel and the category chip row are cut off at the right edge without clear affordance, a restaurant name is truncated mid-word, the favourite heart icons use inconsistent styling, and the second restaurant card is cut off by the bottom tab bar with no visible name/details.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is hard-clipped by the screen edge and its title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without an ellipsis, so the restaurant name is unreadable. The card image also bleeds to the very edge with no gutter matching the left padding.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent horizontal padding/peek to the carousel, add text ellipsis truncation on titles, and ensure the partially visible card shows a consistent sliver so it reads as scrollable content.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is cut off mid-chip at the right edge (a partial rounded chip after 'Healthy'), making it ambiguous whether more filters exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient mask or arrow affordance at the edge of the scrollable chip row, and align the clipped chip so a deliberate peek is shown.

issues.description: The favourite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the first is a white circle with a dark outline heart, the second is a dark/translucent circle with a white heart. Inconsistent treatment looks like a bug and may also reduce contrast on light images.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button to a single style (e.g. semi-opaque white circle with dark heart) across all cards, ensuring adequate contrast over any image.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with -20% badge) is abruptly cut off by the bottom tab bar; its name, rating and delivery info are not visible, and there is no bottom spacing so the content appears clipped rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can fully scroll into view above the navigation bar.

issues.description: Promo/label badges are inconsistent: delivery-time badges on carousel cards use white pills with dark text while the '€0 delivery' and '-20%' badges are also white pills, yet the discount badge lacks colour emphasis typically used for savings, and badge placement differs (some over dark imagery with weak separation).
issues.suggestion: Define a badge system with distinct variants (time, free delivery, discount) using consistent colours, sizes and positioning across all card types.

issues.description: 'See all' links in green on white and the grey 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' placeholder are low-emphasis; the green links may fall below 4.5:1 contrast and placeholder-only search has no visible label.
issues.suggestion: Darken the green used for links to meet WCAG AA contrast and add an accessible label for the search field.

issues.description: The notification bell shows a red dot indicator but no count, and it sits far from the address selector; unclear affordance for users.
issues.suggestion: Add a numeric badge or accessible label such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' to the bell icon.
